correctness.rationale: Convex parabola chord geometry gives success iff nearest opposite-sign magnitudes st<=c<=uv for extreme magnitudes u,v. Failure decomposes into insufficient extreme product and central gap st>c. Integrating joint order statistic densities yields the displayed A_m/B_m and P_m=1-A_m-B_m. Independent SymPy integral evaluation produces P3=(3c/2)(log(1/c)-1+c) and P4=2P3. Boundary Laplace for f(v)=(v+c/v)/2 yields A_m~[2/(1-c)]((1+c)/2)^m, while unique interior saddle of g(s)=1-(s+c/s)/2 yields B_m~sqrt(pi*m*sqrt(c)/(2(1-sqrt(c))))*(1-sqrt(c))^m. At c*=3-2sqrt(2), bases tie but sqrt(m) dominates. Verified symbolic low-m formulas and inspected verifier; not a uniform near-endpoint theorem.
